paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : SMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in Bits Per Character (BPC), of two models—SMoE and SimSMoE—over the course of training, with the x-axis representing training steps scaled by 10³ (i.e., from 0 to 50,000 steps). The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 50 with tick marks every 10 units, and is labeled "Training Steps (×10³)". The y-axis, labeled "BPC", is also linear, ranging from 1.0 to 2.2 with tick marks every 0.2 units. Two lines are shown: the black line with 'x' markers represents SMoE Validating, and the magenta line with star markers represents SimSMoE Validating. Both lines start at high BPC values—SMoE begins near 2.1 and SimSMoE near 2.0—and exhibit a steep decline in the initial training steps. By approximately 20,000 steps, both lines stabilize, with SMoE settling around 1.2 and SimSMoE slightly below at approximately 1.15, maintaining this low BPC level through 50,000 steps. The magenta line (SimSMoE) consistently remains below the black line (SMoE) throughout the training process, indicating lower validation BPC values.
